PROP-01b-partial2-pre-001.text: Interest must be accrued before any borrow operation to prevent stale index exploitation.
PROP-01b-partial2-pre-001.assertion: forall borrow(obl, amt): accrue_interest(reserve, now) called before try_borrow_asset()

locations.note: calls refresh_obligation_borrow_interest_with_new_borrow (NOT global accrue_interest) before try_borrow_asset; does not call market-level accrue_interest for borrow
refreshes interest only for borrow-side obligations, not all assets
